title: Epiphone Hummingbird 12-String, Aged Cherry Sunburst Gloss

long_description.title: A Rarely Offered Iconic 12-String Guitar!
long_description.body:
Inspired by the iconic Gibson™ Hummingbird acoustic, the Epiphone Inspired by Gibson™ Hummingbird™ 12-String produces a clear, bright tone with a beautifully balanced sonic range and comes equipped with a unique Hummingbird pickguard. The Epiphone Inspired by Gibson Hummingbird 12-String has a solid spruce top, solid mahogany back and sides, dovetail neck joint, bone nut and saddle, Fishman® Presys VT™ pickup system, and an aged vintage gloss finish. Hardshell case or EpiLite™ case sold separately.

A battery is not included. To power your pickup, you will need a 9-volt battery.

Electronics Specs.Controls: Fishman Presys VT Soundhole mounted Volume and Tone

Hardware Specs.Strap Buttons: 2 - end pin jack and side of heel

Misc Specs.Case: Optional Acoustic AJ/Dreadnought Hard Case 940-EDREAD; Dread/AJ Acoustic EpiLite™ Case 940-EDREADHG
Misc Specs.Headstock Inlay: Modern Epiphone logo in Mother of Pearl, Gibson Crown in Mother of Pearl
Misc Specs.Strings Gauge: Gibson Coated Phosphor Bronze Acoustic Guitar Strings - Plain Steel .010/.10, .014/.014, Wound .023/.008(p), .030/.012(p), .039/.018(p), .047/.027(w)
